name: GL_PURGE_TRACKING
description: This table stores the archive and purge status for each business object and fiscal year. It stores the current stage of archive and purge, the status of that stage, as well as the Enterprise Service Scheduler requests that executed prior stages.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Business object for which archive and purge is being done. Some valid values are ORA_GL_JOURNALS and ORA_GL_BALANCES.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Calendar for which archive and purge is being done.

columns.name: PERIOD_RANGE_ID
columns.description: Period range for which archive and purge is being done. Currently always maps to a single fiscal year and contains that year.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year for which archive and purge is being done.

columns.name: START_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of the first period in the period range. Currently always maps to the period number of the first period in the fiscal year, which will always be 1.

columns.name: END_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of the last period in the period range. Currently always maps to the period number of the last period in the fiscal year.

columns.name: CURRENT_STAGE_CODE
columns.description: Current overall stage of the archive and purge for the business object and fiscal year. Some valid values are ORA_NEW, ORA_VALIDATE, ORA_ARCHIVE_AND_PURGE, ORA_ARCHIVE_TO_STORAGE, and ORA_CLEAR_ARCHIVE_TABLES.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status within the overall stage. Some valid values are ORA_SUBMITTED, ORA_RUNNING, ORA_SUCCESS, ORA_WARNING, ORA_VALIDATION_ERROR, and ORA_FATAL_ERROR.

columns.name: ERRORS_OVERRIDDEN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether validation errors were overridden.

columns.name: VALIDATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler request that validated whether the business object and fiscal year was ready for archive and purge.

columns.name: PURGE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler request that archived and purged the data for this business object and fiscal year.

columns.name: STORAGE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler request that archived to storage the data for this business object and fiscal year.

columns.name: CLEANUP_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler request that cleared the archive tables for this business object and fiscal year.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
